content: Loaded umbrella AGENTS guidance, CTX-0001 team context, scopes, and the CarryCtx/ctxctl skills. Confirmed the repository is unborn, the task is in progress with no dependencies or conflicts, and shared-checkout work is limited to AGENTS.md plus .carryctx/personas, rules, and workflows. Beginning English-only governance initialization; no product code, commit, or push.

Initialized repository governance without product code: AGENTS.md (86 lines), six focused personas plus catalog, delivery/documentation/security rules, and the Issue-to-merge workflow. The lifecycle maps GitHub Issue through CarryCtx team/task/dependencies/scopes/session, isolated worktree/branch, commit, PR, independent review+CI, merge, bitty-docs synchronization, checkpoint, and closure; the unborn exception is disjoint-scope only. Validation: carryctx doctor healthy (informational hook absence only), canonical GitHub URL present, zero local Markdown link destinations in AGENTS, zero CJK or trailing-whitespace matches in owned files, and git diff --check exits 0. No commit or push.

Created the 50-line English pre-implementation README only. It defines adapter ownership, bitty-docs canonical authority, read-only-by-default and explicit capability boundaries, untrusted observation data, and explicitly disclaims transport, server, adapter, tool, schema, client interoperability, installation, API, compatibility, release, and artifact claims. Validation passed with Prettier 3.9.6, markdownlint-cli2 0.23.1, git diff --check, zero CJK, zero local filesystem Markdown links, zero trailing whitespace, and both <=50 and <=80 line gates.

Commander authorized the shared-checkout unborn-repository exception for this exact bootstrap scope. Independent review must be recorded before staging or publication. The task authorizes only the initial main commit, first push, remote verification, and automatic CI observation.

Independent read-only pre-commit review started under the quality-engineer persona. Reviewing the exact unborn snapshot scope, governance, remote identity, ignored local state, credentials, pre-implementation claims, and CI-equivalent Markdown/hygiene gates before any staging or publication.

Pre-flight inspection (task-mandated ls -la): none of the six matrix files existed in bitty-mcp, so all six are brand-new additions; no skip-because-exists cases. Existing files AGENTS.md, README.md, .gitignore and .carryctx/ were not modified.
LICENSE adapted from reference carryctx-cli: identical MIT body, holder line 'Copyright (c) 2026 The Bitty Terminal Contributors' matching the reference's single-line phrasing style.

CONTRIBUTING.md decision: reference prerequisites list Rust/cargo tooling, which does not apply to bitty-mcp; replaced with the umbrella toolchain policy (bun-only JS toolchain, quality gates via repository justfile). The justfile does not exist yet, so it is referenced in prose only - no markdown link to a nonexistent file. Added explicit delivery lifecycle Issue -> Branch -> Commit -> PR -> Review -> Merge and pointers to AGENTS.md, README.md, SECURITY.md, LICENSE (all resolve in-repo).

SECURITY.md decision: supported-versions table marked unreleased/'No' since no version exists; private reporting via GitHub Security Advisories at bitty-terminal/bitty-mcp; added disclosure policy with acknowledgement (~5 business days) and update cadence (~7 business days) expectations, plus an in-scope note aligned to the untrusted-input doctrine in AGENTS.md. No relative links used, so link-resolution is trivially satisfied.

CHANGELOG.md uses Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 (https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) with SemVer reference and only an '## [Unreleased]' section containing an explicit no-releases-yet statement, consistent with pre-implementation status.

.markdownlint-cli2.jsonc mirrors the reference rule set (default true; MD013 off, MD024 siblings_only, MD033/MD041 off) with ignore globs exactly as the task matrix requires: node_modules, target, dist, build, site (reference also had .worktrees; omitted because it is not in this task's matrix). commitlint.config.ts mirrors the reference byte-for-byte: export default { extends: ['@commitlint/config-conventional'] } - syntactically plausible TypeScript, visual check only per constraint.

Wiring recommendations for a follow-up post-initialization task (NOT done here per hard constraints): add a justfile owning pinned tool versions and quality gates (markdownlint-cli2 0.23.1 via bunx --bun, commitlint via bunx --bun) so gates are never invoked bare; wire lefthook to run commitlint on commit-msg and markdownlint + link check pre-push; initialize CI workflow running those gates plus actionlint; update SECURITY.md supported-versions table at first release; consider adding .worktrees to markdownlint ignores when worktree workflow starts.

FINAL SET. Added (6/6): LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CHANGELOG.md, commitlint.config.ts, .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc. Skipped-because-exists: none. Verification: all six present; relative links in CONTRIBUTING.md (AGENTS.md, LICENSE, README.md, SECURITY.md) resolve in-repo; SECURITY.md has no relative links; CHANGELOG follows Keep a Changelog headings with only [Unreleased]; commitlint config visually valid TypeScript. No existing file modified; no git write operations performed; main had no initial commit at completion time (born-mid-task clause not triggered).

Verification evidence (all inside the worktree): 'just check' passes (markdownlint 17 files 0 issues; prettier all files clean); actionlint -color local pass on ci.yml. Hook enforcement tested via lefthook v2.1.11: TEST A valid message 'chore: verify commitlint gate accepts valid messages' -> commit-msg gate passed, commit created, then reset --hard to 74cae98. TEST B invalid message 'bad message without type' -> rejected with type-empty/subject-empty, exit 1, HEAD unchanged. TEST C staged gate-probe.md with MD009/MD019 + formatting violations -> pre-commit blocked commit (markdown-lint 3 issues, format-check failed), probe unstaged and deleted. Real commit chore(gates) passed through both hooks itself.

Operational notes: (1) 'lefthook install' wrote hooks into the common .git/hooks, so the gates are active for all worktrees including the shared checkout; current tree passes both hooks. (2) A first bun install did not persist bun.lock; re-ran plain 'bun install' which saved it - lockfile is committed. (3) An intermediate 'git reset --hard' briefly reverted tracked-file edits inside the worktree only; edits were reapplied and final commit content is complete (9 files, +139/-8). (4) No GitHub Issue exists yet for CTX-0005; PR body links the task ID per instruction.
